business_summary: Shenzhen Friendcom Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells wireless data transmission in China. The company offers wireless communication products, including outdoor and indoor gateway, pulse reader, and module; wireless M-bus module, module kit, and USB adapter; data radio series; point to point transmission module series, such as RF module; L-CellMesh series; 4G LTE series; and NB-IoT series. It also provides utilities, such as water and gas utilities products; power consumption information collection, including communication unit and terminal products; high voltage power supply device, circuit breaker, fault indicator, distribution automation terminal, and three phase unbalance treatment device; and vehicle charging power supply, car inverter, charging module, electric vehicle motor controller, and photovoltaic inverter. In addition, the company offers test equipment comprising multi meter detection equipment, module power consumption and interface detection, training and simulation testing, dual mode detection, micro power wireless detection, wirelesss public network detection, and carrier and automatic detection. Further, it provides solutions such as LoRa, wireless M-bus, NB-IoT, and intelligent meter reading scheme; and smart grid, public utility, and other solutions. Shenzhen Friendcom Technology Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shenzhen Friendcom Technology Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shenzhen Friendcom Technology Co., Ltd. in May 2026. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, the People's Republic of China.
